evidence.text: Make up and run the 22? surface casing.

text:
Suspend Wellbore

1. Make up and run the 22? surface casing.

2. Circulate & condition mud. Rig up and test cementing lines. Cement the casing as per program -->Pump minimum 4082 ft^3 16.0 ppg class H cement (nitrogen-foamed lead slurry); displace TOC to surface and leave minimum of 100' above float shoe. Check to confirm floats are holding.

3. Close the annulus valves. Release running tool and displace 22" casing to 12.5 ppg WBM.  Pull out of the hole with the running tool and inner string.

4. Install TA cap with ROV.

Completion operations were completed on 11-04-08, with the rig released from locaton on 11-09-08. The well was completed as a single, gravel packed oil completion in the "EP Upper" Sand with exisiting perforations of 12752' - 12790' MD.

text: Zone change operations on ST 34, OCS-G-04842, Well A-2ST1 have been suspended.  Operations began on February 11, 2010 and ended on February 26, 2010.  The previous completion interval, the "R-3" Sand was successfully isolated by setting a TTVBP @ 12405' MD & dumping cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 12356' MD.  It was then discovered that the production pkr @ 12207' MD is leaking and operations were suspended.  Note: There is no sustained csg pressure on the well.  An APM to address the leaking pkr @ 12207' MD and complete zone change operation to expose the "R-1" Sand to production, proposed perfs 12332' - 12350' MD, will be filed at a later date.  Per EOR database requirements, the well status has been noted as temporarily abandoned.
